# Ngosiok Marketing (Super Q)

> Third-generation Filipino noodle manufacturer based in Cebu City, Philippines.
> Maker of Super Q Golden Bihon, the cornstarch bihon widely regarded as the
> benchmark of the category, along with Special Palabok, Pancit Canton,
> Sotanghon and Misua. Founded in Cebu in 1943, re-established in 1945, and
> exporting to the Middle East, North America, Europe and the Asia Pacific.

## Key facts

- Company: Ngosiok Marketing
- Brands: Super Q, Golden Q, First Choice, Eagle VSP, Long Life, Q1
- Founded: 1943 in Cebu; re-established 1945 after the war
- Office: 325 B. Aranas Street, Cebu City 6000, Philippines
- Factory: Cansojong, Talisay City, Cebu, Philippines
- Employees: approximately 200
- Email: sales@ngosiokmarketing.com
- Phone: +63 (32) 2613233 to 2613235
- Website: https://www.superq.ph

## What makes Super Q bihon distinctive

Super Q Golden Bihon is cornstarch-based, not rice-based. Its yellow colour
comes from the cornstarch itself rather than added colouring. It is dried in a
controlled environment rather than sun-dried, which keeps batches free of
foreign matter and consistent year-round. The noodle blocks are compact, giving
a high cooked yield per pack, and the cooked strands stay soft and bouncy
without turning mushy.

## Products

- [Super Q Golden Bihon](https://www.superq.ph/products/super-q-golden-bihon): Cornstarch noodle, fine strands, natural yellow colour. Export packs 227 g / 454 g / 500 g.
- [Super Q Special Palabok](https://www.superq.ph/products/super-q-special-palabok): Cornstarch noodle with thicker strands than bihon.
- [Super Q Pancit Canton](https://www.superq.ph/products/super-q-pancit-canton): Wheat noodle, puffed by deep frying the cooked noodle.
- [Super Q Sotanghon](https://www.superq.ph/products/super-q-sotanghon): Vermicelli glass noodle, translucent when cooked.
- [Super Q Misua](https://www.superq.ph/products/super-q-misua): Fine wheat noodle, traditionally eaten at Chinese birthdays.
- [Q1 Misua](https://www.superq.ph/products/q1-misua): Fine wheat noodle, Philippine market only.
- [First Choice Fresh Japanese Ramen](https://www.superq.ph/products/first-choice-fresh-japanese-ramen): Fresh wheat noodle, also called Hokkien noodles.
- [First Choice Flat Japanese Noodles](https://www.superq.ph/products/first-choice-flat-japanese-noodles): Fresh flat wheat noodle.
- [Long Life Pancit Canton](https://www.superq.ph/products/long-life-pancit-canton): Wheat-based pancit canton.

## Common questions

**Where can I buy Super Q Golden Bihon in Dubai or the UAE?**
Carrefour UAE lists the 227 g and 500 g packs. Shoppers have also reported
stock at Al Madina Supermarket in Salahuddin, Golden Day Hypermarket, and the
Day to Day branch on Al Maktoum Road in Dubai. Supply arrives by container
rather than continuously, so stock can sell through between shipments. Call
the branch before travelling.

**Who manufactures Super Q noodles?**
Ngosiok Marketing, a family-run manufacturer in Cebu City, Philippines.

**Is Super Q bihon made from rice?**
No. Super Q Golden Bihon is cornstarch-based.

**How do I become a distributor?**
Email sales@ngosiokmarketing.com or call +63 (32) 2613233. Private label
packing is available at qualifying order volumes.
